correctness.rationale: The quotient basis is {1,x_v,y_e}, d=1+n+m. A unit multiplier has rank d; nonzero degree-two multiplier rank1. For nonzero linear support S the degree-one multiplication kernel imposes a_i b_j+a_j b_i=0 on edges: free zero-neighborhood outside vertices contribute z_G(S); induced bipartite connected support components contribute one alternating dimension for odd p, while all connected components do for p=2. M_a(1) has a unique degree-one part, so rank=1+n−z−c_p independent of quadratic coefficients. Multiplicity q^m(q−1)^|S| yields exact histogram and annihilator sizes. Full support proves the maximum nonunit rank; the 4-state De Bruijn transfer weights 01 transitions and 000 triples, with correction at full one-support for p=2 or even n. Independently enumerated full F2 triangle multiplication matrices: ranks 0:1, 1:7, 3:56, 7:64, exactly the theorem. Only degree-three-truncated graph face algebra is covered.
